column9: The flagship answer card: an unlicensed mailbox enters a 30-day grace then deletion path (convert to shared first); OneDrive survives while the account exists and follows deleted-user retention after deletion; enrolled devices stay enrolled while license-gated features stop; premium flows and Power BI content suspend. Pair with the offboarding runbook.

Users can buy certain products themselves unless disabled per product via the MSCommerce module; trial sprawl and shadow billing start here. Decide the policy once and script it for every new product Microsoft adds.

Direct and CSP and EA and MCA buy the same SKUs with different terms. New Commerce annual/triennial terms lock seat counts downward mid-term and cancellation is only pro-rated within the first days: seat hygiene beats term regret.
